parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables disallowed operating classes and channels.

parameters.name: OpClass
parameters.description: The Operating Class per {{bibref|802.11ax|Table E-4}}. Note that the operating class identifies the band and channel width.

parameters.name: ChannelList
parameters.description: {{list}} The channel numbers in this Operating Class that are not allowed to be used on this radio.
